name: b2g_roll_toward_orange_goal
description: 1v1, both cars idle far away. The ball is rolled from (0, -2000) at 1500 uu/s toward the orange goal for 20 steps (20 x 8/120 = 1.33 s, so at most 2000 uu). Hand bound: it cannot go further than 2000 uu, so the potential gain is at most Phi(0) - Phi(-2000) = 0.07218 (blue sum <= about 0.0722). The engine slows the ball more than drag alone (measured from the exported run: it ends at y = -241.5, 1758 uu on), and the formula evaluated independently (a separate script) on that measured path gives blue +0.06663, which is what the reward returned (0.0666285). Orange gets the exact negative.

expect.intent: moving the ball toward the opponent goal pays the potential difference along the real path (independent evaluation 0.06663; hard ceiling 0.0722 if the ball had gone the full 2000 uu)
the opponent is charged exactly the same: the reward is antisymmetric, so it is zero-sum without a wrapper
at weight 75 that is about +5 for a 1760 uu carry from just behind midfield to just short of it
